values.note: Reservations run from early May through October. From November to early May only about 21 sites (23-39, 59, 60, 109, 110) stay open, first come, first served, paid with the Scan & Pay app.

values.note: Open all year; in winter only about 21 sites stay open, and the area is usually under snow.

season.source: recreation.gov availability Nov 2026-May 2027 (21 sites open walk-up, 81 closed) + nps.gov/seki Grant Grove text ('usually snow covered in the winter'), read 2026-11-26

note: Kings Canyon National Park campground in mixed conifer forest at Grant Grove, a short walk from the village's visitor center, market and restaurant and from the General Grant Tree. Generators may run 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. Some sites take only tents: the rec.gov listing shows each site's pad length and permitted equipment. --Claude
summary: Azalea (Kings Canyon NP): confirmed $32 all year, 110 sites, flush/water, no hookups; reservable early May-Oct on rec.gov, ~21 walk-up sites stay open Nov-May (fcfs after_cutoff -> some_sites, with a note); pads to 46 ft, 61 sites take a 23-ft rig; pin moved 330 m from the entrance junction to the loop centroid; not waterfront kept.
